summary: The chair hears one round of testimony on two related bills and calls a separate roll on each.
realLife: Columbia's mayor took comments on the proposed election and replacement tax together. Both bills then lost on separate votes.
inGame: The catalog supports city action on bottle deposits. needs: linked hearing and individual rolls.
